Indian Super League 2026-27 Season to Commence October 10

The 2026-27 season of the Indian Super League (ISL) is scheduled to begin on October 10. In this season, the league leaders will be recognized as the Shield Winners and official champions of the ISL. Additionally, the top six teams from the league stage will advance to compete in playoffs for the ISL Cup Champions title.
